title: Launch llama-server with model + GPU-layer plan from the hardware profile
goal: susi ecosystem start llama-cpp currently refuses because it needs a model. Add a launcher that takes a GGUF path, reads its metadata (layers, ctx), computes -ngl/-c/-t from HardwareProfile (VRAM, RAM, cores) and starts llama-server on the configured port, then waits for /health. Tests llamacpp_launcher_* for the planning maths and argv, no real server.
